outsiders.name: Riccardo Wolf
outsiders.text:
A lot of people are saying that mellow-manta, the image model currently being tested on Arena (@arena), is the new Nano Banana Pro. However, I strongly disagree. I've run several tests, and you can take a look at the results yourself.

If this actually turns out to be the new Nano Banana Pro, it would be a complete disaster. But I honestly don't believe that's the case.

To me, mellow-manta looks very similar to MAI Image outputs, especially when it comes to skin textures, the plastic-like appearance, and the tendency to exaggerate skin imperfections.

I've tested mellow-manta extensively, and I want to make one thing clear: it's not a bad model at all.

My point is that we've been waiting a long time for the new Nano Banana Pro, and many people are already sharing mellow-manta as if it's the next version.

If it really turns out to be Nano Banana Pro, I think a lot of people are going to be extremely disappointed.

virals.name: Riccardo Wolf
virals.text:
A lot of people are saying that mellow-manta, the image model currently being tested on Arena (@arena), is the new Nano Banana Pro. However, I strongly disagree. I've run several tests, and you can take a look at the results yourself.

If this actually turns out to be the new Nano Banana Pro, it would be a complete disaster. But I honestly don't believe that's the case.

To me, mellow-manta looks very similar to MAI Image outputs, especially when it comes to skin textures, the plastic-like appearance, and the tendency to exaggerate skin imperfections.

I've tested mellow-manta extensively, and I want to make one thing clear: it's not a bad model at all.

My point is that we've been waiting a long time for the new Nano Banana Pro, and many people are already sharing mellow-manta as if it's the next version.

If it really turns out to be Nano Banana Pro, I think a lot of people are going to be extremely disappointed.

This is a SAMPLE of top-relevance posts, not every post on X. Views = impression_count at fetch time. Missing data shows as 'no data'. Heat = sum log10(views) of topic posts (24 h x1, 24-48 h x0.5), scaled to 100. Momentum = log-views last 24 h / previous 24 h.
